standards.name: USCDI
standards.application: Laboratory Tests, Values/Results, and related specimen and timing elements where available

standards.name: FHIR
standards.application: Observation.code, value[x], interpretation, effective[x], issued, subject, specimen, method and dataAbsentReason; DiagnosticReport groups results

standards.name: US Core
standards.application: Laboratory result Observation and laboratory DiagnosticReport profiles only if source claims and validates this version

standards.name: Bulk Data Access
standards.application: Authorized population export option; not an access grant

standards.name: LOINC
standards.application: Candidate test identity by analyte, property, specimen, scale and method; no universal Lyme-test equivalence

privacy_boundary.patient_level_location: authorized controlled processor outside Atlas downstream product
processing: deduplicate corrections and repeat tests under reviewed method
validate result and two-tier algorithm semantics
assign governed geography and observation week
privacy_boundary.minimum_cell_rule: DEFERRED_PRIVACY_REVIEW; synthetic demonstration uses k=3 only as a fixture rule, not a production threshold

semantics.test_performed: eligible performed assay event; order alone is not a result
semantics.assay_identity: source code plus coding system/version, specimen and method; LOINC mapping is reviewed per assay
semantics.result: qualitative code or quantitative value and unit retained separately from interpretation
semantics.interpretation: source interpretation/flag is not automatically positivity
semantics.positivity: derived under versioned, assay-specific policy after valid result review
semantics.repeat_testing: multiple events for one person require governed person/episode/test deduplication before aggregate counts
semantics.two_tier: screen and confirmatory steps remain distinct; final algorithm status requires reviewed policy
semantics.surveillance_case: confirmed/probable classification is separate jurisdictional case determination; positive test never implies case

aggregate_output.geography_basis: reviewed residence or other specified attribution; unknown/referral geography is excluded or separately state-native, never fabricated county FIPS
aggregate_output.observation_time_basis: reviewed clinically relevant effective time; issued and acquisition times are distinct
aggregate_output.suppression_semantics: suppressed value and potentially revealing numerator/denominator are null; zero is explicit and never inferred from missing data
aggregate_output.destination: existing SourceAdapter then reviewed semantic mapping, metadata, lineage and safe projection; no automatic publication

candidate_signals.numerator: eligible positive results after assay policy
candidate_signals.method: result and two-tier policy; never case count

candidate_signals.denominator: eligible results with interpretable positive/negative outcome

candidate_signals.numerator: current eligible test volume minus historical baseline
candidate_signals.denominator: reviewed comparable historical baseline test volume

candidate_signals.numerator: acquisition time minus latest eligible effective time
candidate_signals.method: lag-aware availability assessment; not a disease measure

deployment_prerequisites: organization agreements or DUA as applicable
